summary: 跨国公司处理语言差异时，可选通用语、员工临时配合、专业翻译或系统培训。文章比较各方案能够应付的场合、付出的成本，以及为什么培训需要长期投入。
logic: 调用员工已有的语言能力
以大众集团说明长期培训

paragraphs.brief: 评估跨国企业语言障碍的三个维度
sentences: The importance of language management in multinational companies has never been greater than today.
多国公司语言管理的重要性从来没有像今天这样大。

Multinationals are becoming ever more conscious of the importance of global coordination as a source of competitive advantage, and language remains the ultimate barrier to aspirations of international harmonization.
多国公司越来越意识到全球协调作为竞争优势来源的重要性，语言仍然是实现国际协调愿望的最终障碍。

Before attempting to consider language-management strategies, companies will have to evaluate the magnitude of the language barrier confronting them and, in doing so, examine it in three dimensions: language diversity, language penetration and language sophistication.
在试图考虑语言管理战略之前，公司必须评估他们面临的语言障碍的严重程度，并在这样做时从三个方面加以审查：语言多样性、语言渗透性和语言精密程度。
Companies next need to turn their attention to how they should best manage language.
公司接下来需要把注意力转向如何最好地管理语言。
There is a range of options from which MNCs can formulate their language strategy.
多国公司可以制定其语言战略，有多种选择。
paragraphs.gist: 跨国协同能带来竞争优势，企业在选择语言策略前，应先从涉及多少语言、语言障碍深入哪些业务及所需熟练程度三方面评估问题。

paragraphs.brief: 单一英语策略的市场与谈判风险
sentences: The simplest answer—though realistic only for English-speaking companies—is to rely on one’s native tongue.
最简单的答案(尽管只对英语公司来说是现实的)是依赖自己的母语。
As recently as 1991 a survey of British exporting companies found that over a third used English exclusively in dealings with foreign customers.
最近，在1991年，对英国出口公司的一项调查发现，三分之一以上公司在与外国客户的交易中专门使用英语。
This attitude that “one language fits all” has also been carried through into the Internet age.
这种“一种语言适合所有人”的态度也已经传到互联网时代。

A survey of the websites of top American companies confirmed that over half made no provision for foreign-language access, and another found that less than 10 % of leading companies were able to respond adequately to e-mails other than in the company’s language.
一项美国大型公司网站调查发现，超过半数不提供外语访问；另一项调查发现，能妥善回复公司工作语言以外邮件的领先企业不到一成。
Widespread though it is, however, reliance on a single language is a strategy that is fatally flawed.
然而，普遍依赖一种单一语言是一种致命的错误战略。

It makes no allowance for the growing trend in linguistic nationalism whereby buyers in Asia, South America and the Middle East in particular are asserting their right to “work in the language of the customer”.
它没有考虑到亚洲、南美洲和中东的买主主张他们有权“用顾客的语言工作”这种日益增长的语言民族主义趋势。
It also fails to recognise the increasing vitality of languages such as Spanish, Arabic and Chinese that over time are likely to challenge the dominance of English as a lingua franca.
这种策略还忽略了西班牙语、阿拉伯语和汉语越来越强的影响力，它们日后可能挑战英语作为通用语的主导地位。

In the IT arena it ignores the rapid globalisation of the Internet, where the number of English-language e-commerce transactions, e-mails and websites is rapidly diminishing as a percentage of the total.
在信息技术领域，它忽视了互联网的迅速全球化，因为英语电子商务交易、电子邮件和网站的数量在总数中所占百分比正在迅速下降。
Finally, total reliance on a single language puts the English speaker at risk in negotiations.
最后，完全依赖单一语言使讲英语的人在谈判中面临风险。
Contracts, rules and legislation are invariably written in the local language, and a company unable to operate in that language is vulnerable.
合同、规则和立法总是用当地语言书写，不能用当地语言经营的公司则很脆弱。
paragraphs.gist: 只用英语看似省事，却可能忽视顾客使用本地语言的要求、其他语言的成长和本地合同法规，使公司在谈判中处于不利地位。

paragraphs.brief: 临时混用语言的便利与误解
sentences: Another improvised approach is to rely on what has been termed “functional multilingualism”.
另一种临时应对方式，是依靠所谓的“实用性多语沟通”。
Essentially, this means muddling through—relying on a mix of languages, pidgins and gestures to communicate by whatever means the parties have at their disposal.
简单说，就是把不同语言、混合语和手势搭配起来，各方手头有什么办法就用什么，尽量把意思讲通。
In a social context such a shared effort might aid bonding, the frustration of communication being regularly punctuated by moments of absurdity and humour.
在社交场合，这种共同努力或许能拉近关系；沟通虽会受挫，途中却不时冒出荒诞有趣的插曲。
However, as the basis for business negotiations it appears very hit-and-miss.
可要用这种方式进行商业谈判，能不能成功很靠运气。
Yet Hagen’s recent study suggests that 16 % of international business transactions are conducted in a “cocktail of languages”.
不过，哈根最近的研究表明，16% 的国际商务交易就是用多种语言混杂的方式进行的。
Functional multilingualism shares the same defects as reliance on a lingua franca and increases the probability of cognitive divergence between the parties.
这种各用所会语言的办法，也有依赖单一通用语时的缺陷，并且更容易使双方对同一件事产生不同理解。
paragraphs.gist: 混用不同语言、简化的混合语和手势能在社交场合拉近距离，但在商业谈判中效果难以预测，双方更容易对同一内容产生不同理解。

paragraphs.brief: 依靠外聘翻译的成本与表达损失
sentences: A more rational response is to employ external resources such as translators and interpreters, and certainly there are many excellent companies specialised in these fields.
更合理的对策是利用笔译和口译等外部资源，当然有许多在这些领域有专长的优秀公司。
However, this is by no means an end to the language barrier.
然而，这绝不是语言障碍的终结。
For a start these services can be very expensive, with a top simultaneous interpreter commanding daily rates as high as a partner in an international consulting firm.
首先，这些服务可能非常昂贵，顶级同声传译员的每日费率可与国际咨询公司的伙伴一样高。

Secondly, any good translator or interpreter will insist that, to be fully effective, they must understand the context of the subject matter—something not always possible owing to complexity, lack of preparation time, or more often the reluctance of the parties to explain the wider context to an outsider.
第二，任何好笔译员或口译员都坚持说，要想充分发挥效力，他们必须了解主题事项的背景——由于复杂性、缺乏准备时间，或者由于当事方不愿意向外人解释更广泛的背景，有些事情并不总是可能的。
Unless there has been considerable pre-explanation, ambiguity and cultural overtones are likely to remain in the source messages.
如果事先没有充分交代背景，原话中的歧义和文化言外之意很可能仍然存在。

Interpreters will of course endeavour to provide a hi-fidelity translation, but in such circumstances they must use initiative and guess-work, clearly injecting a potential source of misunderstanding.
口译员当然会尽力忠实传达原意，但在背景不足时只能临场判断、作出推测，这本身就可能引入误解。

Finally, while a good interpreter will attempt to convey spirit as well as meaning, there is inevitably a loss of rhetorical power; for negotiation, persuasion or humour, an interpreter is a poor substitute for direct communication.
好译员会尽量兼顾字面意思和精神，但原话的感染力难免有所损失，在谈判、说服或传递幽默时，口译很难代替直接沟通。
paragraphs.gist: 外聘译员能提供专业帮助，却成本高且依赖充分背景信息，即使尽力忠实传达，劝说、谈判和幽默中的语气与力量也可能减弱。

paragraphs.brief: 语言培训意愿与持续投入的落差
sentences: The immediate and understandable reaction to any skills shortage is to consider personnel development, and the language-training industry is well developed, offering programmes at almost every level and in numerous languages.
对任何技能短缺的直接和可以理解的反应是，考虑人员发展，语言培训行业发展良好，几乎在每一级别以多种语言提供方案。
However, no company should be deluded into believing training alone guarantees success.
不过，公司不应误以为单靠培训就能保证成功。
Training budgets are geared to the economic cycle: when times are good, money is invested; when belts tighten, training is one of the first luxuries to be pared down.
培训预算随经济周期波动：景气时企业愿意投入，预算吃紧时，培训却常被当成最先削减的奢侈开支之一。

In a study across four European countries nearly twice as many companies said they needed language training in coming years as had conducted it in past years—highlighting the gap between good intentions and delivery.
一项涵盖四个欧洲国家的研究发现，表示未来几年需要语言培训的企业，接近过去几年实际开展培训企业数的两倍，显示意愿和落实之间的落差。
Unless a company is committed to sustaining the strategy even through bad times, it will fail.
除非一个公司承诺即使在坏的时候也要维持这一战略，否则它就会失败。
paragraphs.gist: 培训员工虽然是自然的应对方式，预算却往往在经济不景气时首先被削减，意愿和实际投入之间的落差使长期承诺变得关键。

paragraphs.brief: 大众集团分级语言培训的长期投入
sentences: One notable and committed leader in language training is the Volkswagen Group.
大众集团是重视并长期投入语言培训的代表企业。
Over many years it has developed a language strategy that can be regarded as a model of professional management.
多年来，它制定了一项语言战略，可被视为一种专业管理模式。
Volkswagen treats language training as a strategic solution, not a tactical one.
大众将语言培训视为战略解决办法，而不是战术解决办法。

Progressing from “basics” to full “communication competence” requires completion of six language stages, each demanding roughly 90 hours of classroom refresher work, supplemented by self-study over 6-9 months.
从语言入门达到熟练沟通，要完成六个学习阶段；每阶段约有九十小时课堂复习，并辅以六至九个月的自学。
Each stage ends with an achievement test that is a prerequisite for continuing.
每级结束时都有一次学习成果测试，通过后才能进入下一级。
Even this highly structured programme expects a minimum of three years of fairly intensive study before an accountant, engineer, buyer or salesperson can work effectively in a foreign language.
即使按这套严密的计划，会计师、工程师、采购员或销售人员也预计至少要密集学习三年，才能有效地用外语工作。

Clearly, firms pursuing this route must do so with realistic expectations and long-term commitment; except for brush-up courses for the already fluent, training is not a quick fix and other methods will still be needed.
显然，走这条道路的公司必须抱着现实的期望和长期的承诺这样做；除了为已经流利的人开办复习班之外，培训不是一个快速的解决方案，还需要其他方法。
paragraphs.gist: 大众集团把培训分为六级并逐级考核，即使按计划密集学习，也至少要三年才能用外语工作，说明培训需要长期投入并辅以其他办法。

items.en: What is the main function of this passage?

correct: Evaluate various approaches to the language barrier in multinational companies.
评估多国公司解决语言障碍的各种方法。

pairs: 第 4 段 · 第 7 句
第 2 段 · 第 6 句
points: 回到对应内容“首先，这些服务可能非常昂贵，顶级同声传译员的每日费率可与国际咨询公司的伙伴一样高”，再按题干要求写出答案。

clauses: A survey of the websites of top American companies confirmed …, and another found that less than 10 % of leading companies were able to respond adequately to e-mails other than in the company’s language.
“that over half made no provision for foreign-language access”补足 confirmed 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 confirmed 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
Widespread …, reliance on a single language is a strategy that is fatally flawed.

先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
